The climate in Kaunas

Kaunas is about 40 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 24°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −4°C. Around 700 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in July (about 96 mm).

Best time to visit Kaunas

The most pleasant weather in Kaunas is usually in June, July and August: average highs are between 23°C and 24°C, with up to 14 days of rain a month. In January and February nights are frosty (below −3°C on average) and snow is common.
